title: thelypteris spinosa
intro: Thelypteris spinosa, commonly known as the thorny fern or spiny leather fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Thelypteris spinosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects.
